rows.title: The germinal products set asks for no county parish holding number and no permanent address
rows.detail: Germinal products are not kept on a holding and are never pets, so the germinal set's consignment addresses page, copied from the live-animals one, leaves out the county parish holding number section and the permanent address section, and the set serves neither page. Both halves are the same copied page leaving out a section and its page, so they share one set-up with the germinal consignment addresses page.
acceptanceCriteria: For every germinal commodity, a germinal products notification's consignment addresses page shows exactly five sections, in this order: "Place of origin", "Consignor", "Consignee", "Importer", "Place of destination". (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p9-024, -p9-085; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014, -p1-017, -p1-018, -p1-057)

Every link and button on a germinal products notification's pages opens one of that set's own steps, and none of them opens a county parish holding number page or a permanent address page; opening either page's address under a germinal products notification shows "Page not found". (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-014, -p1-017, -p1-018, -p1-025; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p2-048, -p2-057, -p2-098, -p2-106)
rows.notes: One slice: both requirements are the same copied page leaving out a section and its page, so they share one set-up. They already sit in inc-181 with the germinal consignment addresses page, its pickers and the germinal overview's Addresses task; the combiner keeps them there. The two criteria are worded as inc-181 already carries them. Observable the same way in stub mode and on the compose stack.

splitOff.why: It changes the list of commodities that need a CPH number, held in the live-animals commodity rules (services/commodities/rules.js) and the commodities obligation (obligations/sections/commodities/aggregates.js), which theme commodities-and-reason owns; the skip off the CPH page is already built.
It changes the CPH section's add link on the live-animals consignment addresses page (features/addresses copy and template), which theme consignment-parties owns.

The consignment addresses page already shows the slashed CPH number with its Change link; what is left is the review page's CPH row (check-answers/view-model/cards), which theme overview-and-review owns.
It sets the amend button set on the CPH number and permanent address pages; the 27 November ruling builds prototype changes that reach amending on the manage-notifications theme's branch.
